title: The Selfish man at the counter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：selfish　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 selfish 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the builder wrote of ① a selfish man at the counter in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more selfish than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the selfish ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most selfish man at the counter anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too selfish to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the selfish ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a selfish reason for the delay, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as selfish as the reason for the delay they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was selfish or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something selfish, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite selfish; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the selfish ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, for the whole place, she wrote of another selfish man at the counter in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more selfish than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most selfish reason for the delay in the whole site, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the selfish ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自私（前置定语 a selfish man at the counter：1958 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件自私的男人）
B. adj. 自私／只顾自己（比较级 more selfish than：文中两处，一处比柜台后自私的男人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 自私／只顾自己（最高级 the most selfish：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自私（表语 too selfish to do：母亲觉得它太自私，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 只顾自己（前置定语 a selfish reason for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩只顾自己的拖延理由）
F. adj. 只顾自己（同级比较 as selfish as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩出于私心的拖延理由相比）
G. adj. 只顾自己（后置定语 something selfish：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 只顾自己（受程度副词修饰 quite selfish：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a selfish man at the counter
the most selfish man at the counter anybody
a selfish reason for the delay
The most selfish reason for the delay in

answers.why: selfish 意为“自私”，1958 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件自私的男人”，此处作前置定语 a selfish man at the counter。
selfish 意为“自私”，此处用比较级 more selfish than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
selfish 意为“自私”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最自私的一件，故用最高级 the most selfish man at the counter。
selfish 意为“自私”，母亲认为这件东西“太自私了，谁也用不上”，too selfish to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
selfish 意为“只顾自己”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩只顾自己的拖延理由”，此处作前置定语 a selfish reason for the delay。
selfish 意为“只顾自己”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩出于私心的拖延理由一样只顾自己”，同级比较用 as selfish as。
selfish 意为“只顾自己”，施工图上那半行字要的是“只顾自己的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something selfish。
selfish 意为“只顾自己”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当只顾自己”，quite 修饰原级 selfish。
selfish 意为“只顾自己”，1968 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要只顾自己”，故用比较级 more selfish than。
selfish 意为“只顾自己”，母亲 1970 年说的是“整个工地里最只顾自己的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most selfish reason for the delay。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件自私的男人。（a selfish man at the counter）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更自私。（more selfish than …）
母亲觉得它太自私，谁也用不上。（too selfish to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩只顾自己的拖延理由。（a selfish reason for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩出于私心的拖延理由一样只顾自己。（as selfish as …）
到了 1965 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件只顾自己的东西。（something selfish）
answers: In 1958 the builder wrote of a selfish man at the counter in the plan.
Everybody said it was more selfish than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too selfish to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a selfish reason for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as selfish as the reason for the delay they had once had.
By 1965 the plan asked for nothing but something selfish.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 selfish 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the builder wrote of a selfish man at the counter in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most selfish man at the counter in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too selfish to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a selfish reason for the delay, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite selfish, and everybody laughed.
The selfish ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
